name: gitlab-mcp-community
description: Community GitLab MCP server with GraphQL discovery and team-activity analytics. Read-only build. Not affiliated with GitLab Inc.'s first-party MCP server.

gitlab_url.title: GitLab URL
gitlab_url.description: Base URL of your GitLab instance (e.g. https://gitlab.com or your self-hosted host).

gitlab_read_token.title: GitLab Read-Only PAT
gitlab_read_token.description: Personal access token with read_api scope. Stored in your OS keychain. Writes (create_issue, create_merge_request, etc.) will be rejected by this bundle — install via npm/GHCR if you need write access.
